items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: I don't know who that is. It's Charlie Moore.

ctx.x: I'll tell you in a minute. I think that's Metcalf, Larry Metcalf. Played pretty good. The band's got a good beat. That's Larry Metcalf.
I don't know who that is. It's Charlie Moore. I wonder why that guy didn't ever take up clarinet.

Good ideas. Good ideas. That's a great part, Foster. I wonder why that guy didn't ever take up clarinet. Good ideas. Good ideas. Good ideas. Good ideas. That's a great part, Foster. Good ideas. There you are. I wonder if that's the record that... ...Wooden Krala dropped his four steaks.
